messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - High GPU queue latency in us-east-1. 90th pct token latency > 3s for hosted text-gen routes. Affects ~15% of requests. Auto-escalating to on-call.

sarah: I have the page, jumping in. tagging @dylan for routing/traffic shifts.

dylan: on it. checking autoscaler logs and pool health. give me 2m.

opsbot: autoscaler-error: failed to scale up: quotaExceeded: requested vGPUs > quota (region: us-east-1)

carol: noted customer impact - some PLG calls maybe getting 502s/timeouts. will prepare status snippet.

nate: @sarah can you confirm if fallback model group is enabled for these routes?

sarah: fallback enabled but not active because autoscaler didn't add nodes. applying temporary traffic-shift to smaller model (rwd-micro-v1) now.

Dylan: applied routing override:
```
POST /api/v1/routing/override
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "target": "rwd-micro-v1", "percent": 100 }
```

dylan: traffic shift in effect. latency dropped for a subset, errors decreasing. still watching queues. :eyes: 

maria: pushed a short status update to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased latency in us-east-1. Some requests are routed to fallback models to reduce errors." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2251234567

carol: drafting customer-facing email for impacted tenants. short + transparent. cc @maria to review.

opsbot: infra-log: kube-node-gpu-7 terminated unexpectedly; preemption detected by cloud provider.

nate: looks like region had a burst of preemptions, autoscaler hit quota prevented new node creation. root cause likely cloud-side capacity + our safety quota checks.

sarah: decision: 1) keep routing override for 30m while we stabilize 2) open a quota request with provider priority 3) schedule post-incident review for tomorrow 10:00am PT. owner: sarah.

dylan: created incident tracker INFRA-3421 with initial notes and actions. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3421

carol: action items (brief):
- INFRA-3421-1: request increased GPU quota for us-east-1 (owner: nate, ETA: 24h)
- INFRA-3421-2: add alert for autoscaler scale_fail events (owner: dylan, ETA: 48h, PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789)
- INFRA-3421-3: add preflight check for eviction rate and trigger early traffic-shift (owner: sarah, ETA: 72h)
- INFRA-3421-4: update runbook with routing override command and TTL (owner: carol, ETA: 24h)

sarah: quick note for postmortem: include customer impact window, why autoscaler couldn't scale, and a mitigation plan for capacity shortfalls across regions.

maria: I notified the top 5 paying tenants via support channel with ETA and mitigation steps. logged tickets: SUP-6112, SUP-6113.

dylan: monitoring: queue length back to baseline, 95th pct latency ~480ms after routing. will keep routing override until autoscaler backfills or we revoke.

opsbot: follow-up: schedule_postmortem(incident=2251234567, time="2026-03-18T17:00:00Z", owner="sarah") -> success

nate: PR open to add autoscaler error alert: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/444. linking to INFRA-3421.

carol: created retrospective doc and added early notes: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/2251234567

sarah: thanks team. postmortem scheduled. keeping INFRA-3421 as source of truth for remediation. will update thread as actions move to done. :white_check_mark:
